title: Chronicle bench sampler and CI sentinel for phase-aware prefill/decode
creator: Asha Banerjee
description: Deliver a lightweight, phase-aware benchmarking harness (Chronicle) and an accompanying CI sentinel that captures prefill-to-decode interactions and surface regressions driven by kernel routing and attention optimizations. Chronicle will produce reproducible workload samplers that encode phase transitions (prefill -> decode), attention-window distributions, and kernel-routing fingerprints so we can compare golden baselines across hardware and model variants. The CI sentinel will run stratified micro-samples of Chronicle at PR time and nightly, compute quantile deltas (p50/p90/p99) and guard against regressions using thresholded alerts and automated rollback signals. Goals: 1) reduce CI noise while catching regressions that affect tail latency and correctness under realistic phase mixes; 2) provide a compact golden artifact format (seed-locked, phase-tagged traces) that the runtime can replay deterministically for kernel selection reviews; 3) integrate results into Console dashboards and CI gates for runtime-1.22 release planning.
acceptance_criteria: Chronicle sampler can generate and persist phase-tagged workload shards (prefill/decode mix) for at least three representative models (rw-7b, rw-13b, rw-16k)
Golden artifact format defined and consumed by a replay harness that locks RNG seeds and kernel probe flags so runs are reproducible across identical hardware
CI sentinel config added to repo that runs a <10 minute stratified sample per PR and nightly expanded runs; sentinel posts quantile diffs to the perf dashboard and fails PRs on p99 regression > 8%
Dashboard panel created linking golden artifact ID, run metadata, and kernel-routing heatmaps; alerts wired to #runtime-perf on slack
Runbook documenting when to relax gates, how to triage noisy tails, and remediation steps (fallback model, canary launch)
tasks: Design Chronicle artifact schema (phase tag, seed, kernel-probe snapshot, input corpus pointer)
Implement sampler that stitches real customer-like prompts into prefills with decode continuations and exports locked traces
Add replay harness that enforces kernel probe settings and deterministic prefill/decoder pacing
Build CI sentinel job (lightweight stratified sampler) and integrate into GitHub Actions with perf audit step
Expose perf outputs to Console (new runtime-perf panel) and add alerting rules for p99 regressions
Run sensitivity analysis across batch sizes, quantization profiles, and attention-window splits; record kernel-selection deltas
comments: 2026-02-26 - Kickoff: Reviewed objectives with runtime and infra leads. Decided to prioritize determinism (seed-locking + kernel-probe enforcement) over maximum fidelity for initial rollout.

2026-03-01 - Design review: PM asked for a compact artifact that can be stamped with release IDs. We landed on a single-line JSONL artifact per trace with a checksum and hardware-tag. Action: Asha to draft schema.

2026-03-04 - Implementation note: initial sampler produced heavy tails under mixed prefill lengths; adjusted sampling distribution to match production traffic histogram (sourced from telem: /dashboards/prefill-corpus) and reduced long-prefill fraction to 12%.

2026-03-06 - Experiment result: replay harness on a control matrix (rw-7b on A100 vs H100 emu) shows 6.2% improvement in p99 when enabling attention-window clipping optimization; p90 stable. Captured kernel-routing snapshot for follow-up.

2026-03-09 - Blocker: observed nondeterministic kernel selection on heterogeneous rack under transient temperature throttling; introduced kernel-probe guard that pins kernel version and rejects runs that don't match the probe fingerprint.

2026-03-11 - PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime-bench/pull/214 — Chronicle sampler + replay harness. Requesting review from @sylvia-ops for infra quota and @ivan-ml for eval-sanity checks.

2026-03-12 - Reviewer feedback (Ivan): suggested adding a small synthetic cohort of attention-stress prompts to catch regressions that only surface with long-sparse attention patterns. Marcus to add to sampler config.
